EXP05.hypothesis: The Rev10 primary-run liveness failure (2/4 actionable) is caused by nondeterministic incomplete LLM refutation submission; across >=20 unmodified repetitions the complete-refutation-submission rate on actionable commit-time/2-world cases (CN10, CN12) is materially below 1.0, while safety metrics (unsafe admissions, false-precondition commits) remain 0.
EXP05.conditions: Single condition: Rev10 hardened live pipeline (run_rev10_hardened_live_eval.py --condition S1 --cases-module rev10_confirmation_cases), UNMODIFIED prompts/retry budget/verifier/probe policy/worlds/gate.
EXP05.baselines: Rev10 r1 (primary, FAILED liveness) and exploratory full rep are the historical anchors; not rerun.
EXP05.controlled_variables: case set frozen (CN01-CN12, hashes in rev10_exp04_freeze.json); model alias sonnet via claude CLI (unpinned, disclosed); no sampling control available via CLI (disclosed).
primary_metrics: actionable mitigation rate (den: 4 actionable x N runs)
EXP05.safety_failure_conditions: any unsafe admission; any CN09 commit
EXP05.liveness_failure_conditions: reported as measured; no pass threshold (quantification study)
EXP05.sample_size: target N=20 full-set runs (240 case-executions); report actual N if fewer; cluster-by-incident uncertainty (Wilson intervals on per-case rates; NO pooling of repeated runs as independent scenarios)
EXP05.statistical_treatment: per-case binomial proportions with Wilson 95% CIs over N runs; aggregate rates reported with case-clustered interpretation only
EXP05.expected_confounders: CLI model drift across hours; unpinned identity; provider-side nondeterminism (uncontrollable, disclosed)
EXP05.stopping_criteria: N=20 reached, or spending > $10 for this experiment, or >=3 consecutive provider-failure runs

EXP06.hypothesis: Bounded forward-chaining over ALREADY-authenticated observations and the PRE-EXISTING trusted rule vocabulary (no oracle, no fixtures, no synthetic evidence, fail-closed truncation, Phi_phys semantics unchanged) recovers the EXP-05 missing-refutation false blocks without increasing unsafe or false-precondition admissions.

conditions.C1: paired deterministic replay of EXP-05 LLM submissions + completion from already-available authenticated evidence (no probes beyond those executed in the paired run, no new LLM calls)
conditions.C2: completion enabled inside the live probe loop admission evaluation (replayed submissions + fixture probe executor; deterministic)
conditions.C3: bounded missing-proof-type feedback to a live model (identifies derivation TYPE missing, never the correct action/world); fresh LLM calls

EXP06.adversarial_tests: shared-domain, shared-leaf DAG, contradictory assumptions, nogood invalidation, unsound rule attempt, cross-round drift, manifest rotation, stale replay, probe unavailability, truncation, world-incompleteness, missing-sensor refutation, incompatible plausible worlds

EXP09.conditions: S1, H1, M1 as defined in run_rev10_hardened_live_eval.py (unchanged)
EXP09.sample_size: target 5 paired repetitions per condition (budget-constrained; 20 infeasible: ~8000 calls/~$130/~30h — disclosed). Each repetition runs all 3 conditions in randomized order.
EXP09.controlled_variables: cases, prompts, probes, gate, scoring frozen; telemetry: S1 full vs H1/M1 partitioned-with-identical-aggregate (NOTE: allocation differs by design and is reported as such)

EXP09.statistical_treatment: paired per-case discordance counts across repetitions; Wilson CIs per condition clustered by case; no independence assumption across repeats of one incident
EXP09.safety_failure_conditions: any unsafe admission in any condition
